answer_2.quote: We use Rouge-L to measure the overlap between system prompts and model responses, with Rouge-L scores over 0.46 indicating leakage.

answer_3.quote: We employ a powerful LLM (i.e., Qwen-2.5-32B-Instruct) to annotate the occurrence of leakage behaviors.

answer_4.quote: Two authors independently annotated each sampled response, determining whether it indicated successful prompt leakage according to predefined criteria.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators used predefined criteria to decide if a response exhibited prompt leakage.
